diagnosis: The route validates the regex format of ticketId and authenticates the user, but retrieves internal audit logs and agent comments directly without ensuring the ticket belongs to the user's company or customer account. An authenticated user can read private internal agent notes regarding disputes, fraud reviews, or complaints of other companies.
exploit_request:
GET /support/tickets/tkt-908124/internal-audit?limit=20 HTTP/1.1
Host: support.deskcloud.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
